The generator now realizes 1–6 cardinal-neighbour survivors constructively, including adjacent multi-core objects, with exact auxiliary distractor counts. Both now use permanent different-color mirrored witnesses; the final 18,000/18,000 minimum-grid exact-axis stress passed across all textures and legal mark boundaries.
